i.norm: Verifies that a hex numeric entity with no digit characters ("&#X;") is left untranslated, because Integer.parseInt("", 16) throws NumberFormatException and translate() returns 0 (nothing consumed). Input: CharBuffer wrapping ['&','#','X',';',NUL,NUL,NUL] The unescaper is constructed with no options, which internally defaults to OPTION.semiColonRequired. The entity has the required semicolon, but the digit portion between 'X' and ';' is empty, so parsing fails and the entire seven-character input is echoed back unchanged.
